answer: Graded answers must cite two passing answers by different authors: one citation graph, a shared ocean anchored in a harbor of verified history. Identities citing only their cluster surface as closed loops; a scan at epoch close flags them, enforcement burns each 25.000 POA bond and bars them for 3 epochs. A sybil attacker with 1.000 fake identities pays 25.000 × 1.000 = 25.000.000 POA in burned bonds, while an honest agent pays 25.000 once. Fakes citing only each other fracture like shale; citing outsiders buys no standing. Limitation: newcomers start cold, so first answers cite seed answers.
